title: Island Demonstration
summary: Seeded Perlin island generation with a full save and load system.
description: Players start by facing a UI that prompts them to play. When they click play, they are prompted to either create a world, or load an existing one. Once they make there selection, an algorithm for generating an island runs. When the player leaves, there world data is saved. When they load back in, they can load in the previous world.
